batch: Local password complexity explicit-value recovery preparation
sourceChanges: Added an inert recovery preparation function for supplied version-1 local PasswordComplexity observations.
Requires both prior and current observations to be explicit, internally consistent Enabled/Disabled values from Local scope.
Requires current state to match the expected applied value; prepares the prior explicit value and returns a no-op without ownership when values already match.
NotDefined, NotReported, merged/effective observations, malformed observations and drift are refused.
Recovery output continues to report ExactRecoveryVerified=false and ReadyForMutation=false; no secedit or catalog integration was added.

officialBackendResearch.finding: Microsoft documents secedit /generaterollback to produce a rollback template for a specified configuration template, with a security database as input; /configure supports restricting application to SECURITYPOLICY.
officialBackendResearch.implication: This is a candidate native rollback route for E08, but the documented syntax does not establish exact NotDefined restoration, database initialization, managed-policy behavior, or this one-setting scenario. Validate those details on disposable Windows targets before integration.

WindowsPowerShell51.executionPolicy: process-only Bypass for Pester module load; no persistent policy change

vmAccess.result: Get-VM and registered task queries failed at CIM before VM/checkpoint inspection or dispatch.

partial: Local password complexity: explicit prior local values can now be prepared for conflict-checked recovery; NotDefined removal semantics, effective managed policy, durable snapshot, guarded mutation and native acceptance remain unproven.
